title: On Interpreting the signs of coming rain
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：interpret　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 interpret 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the father ① interpreted the signs of coming rain in public, and every neighbour in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the father ② interprets the signs of coming rain in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ interpret the signs of coming rain at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ interpreted the signs of coming rain before — a line in the letter for September 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Interpreting the signs of coming rain in public, the father said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ interpret for the merchant from the south in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Interpret for the merchant from the south at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the letter, and a new neighbour from the next house ⑧ interprets for the merchant from the south in public every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the door, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ interpreted the signs of coming rain again when nobody else would.

⑩ To interpret the signs of coming rain, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the house remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the house forgets, somebody interprets the signs of coming rain in silence again and somebody must interpret the signs of coming rain in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 解释（一般过去式 interpreted the signs of coming rain：1991 年父亲头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 解释（一般现在 interprets the signs of coming rain：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 解释（不定式 to interpret the signs of coming rain：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 解释（过去完成时 had interpreted the signs of coming rain：1985 年九月的家书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 解释（动名词 interpreting the signs of coming rain 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 口译（interpret for the merchant from the south：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去口译为那位南方商人做口译）
G. v. 口译（interpret for the merchant from the south：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 解释（后段两处：新来的邻居照例 interprets for the merchant from the south，而母亲又一次 interpreted the signs of coming rain）

answers.why: interpret 意为“解释”，1991 年父亲当着众人面解释解释下雨前的那些征兆，那是老屋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 interpreted。
interpret 意为“解释”，自那以后父亲一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 interprets。
interpret 意为“解释”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯解释解释下雨前的那些征兆”，此处为不定式 to interpret the signs of coming rain。
interpret 意为“解释”，家书里 九月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人解释过，故用过去完成时 had interpreted。
interpret 意为“解释”，父亲说“解释解释下雨前的那些征兆这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 interpreting the signs of coming rain 作主语。
interpret 意为“口译”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去口译为那位南方商人做口译”，should ever 之后用原形 interpret for the merchant from the south。
interpret 意为“口译”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻口译为那位南方商人做口译（interpret for the merchant from the south at once），以后再也不要提起。
interpret 意为“解释”，新来的邻居每个月份都照例口译为那位南方商人做口译，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 interprets。
interpret 意为“解释”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面解释解释下雨前的那些征兆，用一般过去式 interpreted 叙述。
interpret 意为“解释”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要解释解释下雨前的那些征兆，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和老屋记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 interpret 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the father interpreted the signs of coming rain in public, and nobody in the house forgot it.
Even now the father interprets the signs of coming rain in silence whenever the house asks.
Interpreting the signs of coming rain in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever interpret for the merchant from the south in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next house interprets for the merchant from the south in public every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother interpreted the signs of coming rain again, and the house remembered that half.
